topic: Ship the user-ordered item shop / crafting system in the beta (commit as-is, reshape, or revert)
context: Human directive, verbatim: 'add a item craft / buy shop a bit like dota 2 / league of legends'. Engine/gameplay code is deepseek's ownership per design/COLLAB.md; QA harness and tools/qa/ are mimo's; collaboration.md is mimo's file and was not touched. Also fixed a latent revive bug (hero came back at level-1 stats).
